dish_name: spicy vegetable and tofu dry pot
components: spicy vegetable and tofu dry pot
source: generic recipe written by claude-opus-5-5 from the dish name only; not taken from any recording

steps.component: spicy vegetable and tofu dry pot
steps.text: Fetch the tofu, mushrooms, celery, cauliflower and cilantro from the fridge
steps.checkpoint: fridge items are on the counter

steps.component: spicy vegetable and tofu dry pot
steps.text: Fetch the potato, lotus root, onion, chili bean paste, hot pot base, dried chilies, Sichuan peppercorns, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sugar, sesame seeds, oil and salt
steps.checkpoint: pantry items are on the counter

steps.component: spicy vegetable and tofu dry pot
steps.text: Get out the wok, cutting board, knife, peeler, pot, slotted spoon and serving dish

steps.component: spicy vegetable and tofu dry pot
steps.text: Pat the tofu dry and cut into thick slices

steps.component: spicy vegetable and tofu dry pot
steps.text: Peel and slice the potato and lotus root
steps.checkpoint: potato and lotus root are sliced

steps.component: spicy vegetable and tofu dry pot
steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into small florets and tear or slice the mushrooms

steps.component: spicy vegetable and tofu dry pot
steps.text: Cut the celery into sections and slice the onion

steps.component: spicy vegetable and tofu dry pot
steps.text: Slice the garlic and ginger and snip the dried chilies

steps.component: spicy vegetable and tofu dry pot
steps.text: Blanch the potato, lotus root and cauliflower until just tender and drain

steps.component: spicy vegetable and tofu dry pot
steps.text: Pan-fry the tofu in oil until golden and set aside

steps.component: spicy vegetable and tofu dry pot
steps.text: Fry the potato, lotus root, cauliflower and mushrooms in oil until lightly browned and set aside
steps.checkpoint: vegetables are browned at the edges

steps.component: spicy vegetable and tofu dry pot
steps.text: Fry the Sichuan peppercorns, dried chilies, garlic and ginger in oil until fragrant

steps.component: spicy vegetable and tofu dry pot
steps.text: Add the chili bean paste and hot pot base and fry until the oil turns red

steps.component: spicy vegetable and tofu dry pot
steps.text: Return all vegetables and tofu with the onion and celery, add soy sauce and sugar and toss on high heat
steps.checkpoint: everything is coated in the spicy paste

steps.component: spicy vegetable and tofu dry pot
steps.text: Transfer to the serving dish and sprinkle with cilantro and sesame seeds
steps.checkpoint: dry pot is served and garnished
